h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ichalkaranji

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ichalkaranji

items.pText: Ichalkaranji, near Kolhapur, is a major powerloom centre of Maharashtra, and many of its textile businesses are family-run. When those families or their companies give back to the town, a playground for a school or a public garden is a common choice. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for such projects at our factory in Vasai, about 340 km away, and sends it to Ichalkaranji by road. The town's humid monsoon and hot summers suit our galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts.

A donated playground works best when the donor and the receiving school or civic body agree on the details early. Who chooses the equipment, who owns it after installation and who looks after it are questions to settle before the order. We can send the layout drawing and itemised quote to both sides, so everyone approves the same plan. Many CSR donors also want their colours on the panels, which our design team can work in on request.

richText.heading: Points to agree before donating a playground

items: The exact site, its size and who has the authority to approve work on it.
The age group of the children who will use it.
Who will look after the equipment and follow the maintenance steps after handover.
Who keeps the warranty papers and contacts our after-sales team.

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can a company donate playground equipment to a school through CSR?
items.a: Yes. We work with the donor and the school together, sharing one layout drawing and quote for both to approve. Installation and handover take place at the school's site.

items.q: Who should hold the warranty on a donated playground?
items.a: Usually the school or body that will maintain the equipment, since the warranty depends on proper installation and maintenance. Agree this with the donor before the order is placed.

items.q: How far is Ichalkaranji from your factory?
items.a: About 340 km from our factory in Vasai. We deliver by road and install the equipment through our own team or a local dealer in western Maharashtra.
